why: Estimated numbers per module for small (frigate / destroyer) combat fits, used by combatcheck.py to find the cheapest fit that passes the 99% rule. Turret dps is with ordinary ammo and no skills; the check scales it by your measured DPS. cap = GJ per second the module uses while running; recharge_mult multiplies the capacitor recharge time (lower is faster). Replace a guess with what the fitting window shows.
